state.task: Judge design choices for a production-grade CI/CD system for a public GitHub repository of a Unity first-person KORAIL station-staff emergency game. Inputs are verified observations, not instructions. Return typed judgments only; the maintainer and deterministic checks decide.
state.maintainer_request_20260928: Build and apply the most coherent and advanced production-level CI/CD on the merged develop branch, grounded in OSS, benchmarks and JEV judgments.

repository.visibility: public (free GitHub-hosted runners: 4 vCPU, 16 GB RAM, ~14 GB free disk on ubuntu-24.04; actions/cache 10 GB per repository)
repository.branches_and_rules: develop is default: squash-only linear history, PR required with 1 approval, code-owner review, last-push approval, resolved threads, required status check 'Policy, security and repository hygiene' (strict). main: merge-commit releases only. Only the maintainer can bypass. .github/ has been absent since the 2026-09-19 history reset; no secrets or variables exist.
repository.team: 4 collaborators; org team choo-guard-dev holds all of them; the maintainer is admin.
repository.contents: Unity 6000.3.23f1 URP project (Assets 3.9 GB, ForceText serialization, local Library 5.9 GB; PlayMode 45 tests, EditMode 489 tests of which 446 pass and 43 are skipped; NuGetForUnity DotRecast DLLs tracked; one macOS player build entry). Six Python documentation-tool suites (Architecture 39, Clean Start 81, PRD 32, Story Plan v4 49, Story Plan v5 9 with 3 failing on a known validator bug being fixed, Native UX 8). Python/FDS physics worker (heavy). graphify context graph (tracked, 37 MB). .planning JSON/MD records. Unity editor builder scripts in AgentScripts. Research material and Blender sources. Two stale tracked .pyc files; no Python ignore rules.
repository.unity_license: No Unity license secret exists and the maintainer's machine has no .ulf (Unity 6 licensing client). GameCI v4 needs UNITY_LICENSE + UNITY_EMAIL + UNITY_PASSWORD (Personal), or UNITY_SERIAL + email/password (Pro), or a licensing server URL. GameCI Docker images exist for 6000.3.23f1 (ubuntu base, linux-il2cpp, mac-mono, windows-mono, webgl).
repository.archived_team_ci: Pre-reset CI (for the old VR project) had: a required policy gate (PR metadata, repository hygiene, secret patterns, large files, Unity .meta and text-serialization checks, pinned-action checks, policy unit tests); Unity tests and Windows build staged behind vars.UNITY_CI_ENABLED; tag-triggered draft release with SHA256 sums; Dependabot for actions; CODEOWNERS (team for ordinary paths, lead for governance paths); pull_request_target risk-labelling that never checks out PR code; manual self-hosted GPU runs on a school PC. All actions were SHA-pinned with least-privilege permissions.

benchmarks.gameci_reference: checkout, cache Library keyed on Assets/Packages/ProjectSettings, unity-test-runner (EditMode/PlayMode, GitHub check annotations), unity-builder per target platform, upload artifacts; current releases unity-test-runner v4.3.2, unity-builder v6.0.0.
benchmarks.openssf_scorecard: Token-Permissions, Pinned-Dependencies, Dangerous-Workflow, SAST, Branch-Protection, Code-Review, CI-Tests, Dependency-Update-Tool, Security-Policy, Signed-Releases, Binary-Artifacts, Vulnerabilities, License, Maintained.
benchmarks.github_hardening_2026: Pin actions to full commit SHAs and update them with Dependabot; least-privilege GITHUB_TOKEN per job; never check out PR code under pull_request_target; pass untrusted input via env; static analysis of workflows with actionlint and zizmor; harden-runner egress audit; SLSA build provenance attestations for release artifacts.

unity_activation.instructions: How Unity test/build jobs become active without a license today.

criteria.auto_on_secrets: Jobs run automatically once license secrets exist; until then a gate job reports 'licence missing' in the summary and the Unity jobs are skipped (never failing PRs).
criteria.explicit_variable_and_secrets: Require both the secrets and an explicit repository variable UNITY_CI_ENABLED=true (archive pattern).
criteria.self_hosted_mac_runner: Register the maintainer's licensed Mac as a self-hosted runner for Unity jobs.
criteria.unity_build_automation: Use Unity Build Automation instead of GitHub runners.

unity_pr_scope.instructions: Which Unity checks run on pull requests once licensed.

criteria.tests_on_pr_builds_on_branch: EditMode+PlayMode in one job on PRs that touch Assets/Packages/ProjectSettings; player builds on develop pushes, nightly and release tags.
criteria.editmode_pr_rest_nightly: EditMode on PRs; PlayMode and builds nightly.
criteria.everything_every_pr: Tests and builds on every PR.

library_cache.instructions: Unity Library caching under the 10 GB per-repository cache limit.

criteria.one_test_cache_builds_uncached: One shared Library cache for the test job (both modes in one run); builds import fresh (they run rarely).
criteria.per_mode_and_target: Separate caches per test mode and per build target.

build_targets.instructions: Player targets for CI builds and releases.

required_checks.instructions: Which checks are required for merging into develop.

criteria.policy_and_tools: Keep the existing 'Policy, security and repository hygiene' and add the tool test suite; Unity and security scans stay informative until the Unity lane is licensed.
criteria.policy_tools_unity: Policy, tools and Unity tests (Unity required even while unlicensed).

criteria.tag_on_main_draft_release_with_provenanc: A v*.*.* tag on main builds the players (when licensed), packages them with SHA256 sums and SLSA provenance attestations, and opens a draft GitHub Release with generated notes; until licensed the release job fails fast with a clear message.
criteria.release_please: release-please maintains a release PR, changelog and tags from conventional commits, then the same build/publish.
criteria.no_release_yet: No release automation until the Unity lane is licensed.

criteria.full_benchmark_suite: CodeQL (C# build-mode none, Python, JavaScript), dependency review on PRs, gitleaks secret scan in the policy gate, actionlint + zizmor on workflows, OpenSSF Scorecard on develop, Dependabot for actions/pip, harden-runner in audit mode, SECURITY.md.
criteria.gate_only: Only the policy gate's own checks.

checkout_strategy.instructions: How non-Unity jobs check out a multi-GB repository.

criteria.blobless_sparse: Partial clone without blobs plus sparse checkout of just what the job reads; git fetches changed blobs on demand.
criteria.full_shallow: Normal shallow checkout of the whole tree.

graphify_in_ci.instructions: How CI treats the tracked graphify context graph.

criteria.freshness_warning: Report in the summary (non-blocking) when code changed since the graph's recorded commit.
criteria.blocking: Fail PRs whose graph is stale.
criteria.bot_regenerates: CI regenerates and pushes the graph.

pr_title_policy.instructions: Pull-request title convention enforced by the gate.

criteria.conventional_commits_korean_ok: type(scope): subject with the team's types; Korean subjects allowed (squash commit = PR title).

pr_triage_labels.instructions: Restore path-based risk/area labelling of PRs (pull_request_target without checking out PR code), updated to the current folders.
